265.trigger: 来访者提及父母、同住/经济情况或独生背景，或档案not yet记录相关信息时。

364.skill_name: 摄入性会谈与登记表采集身份教育信息
364.skill_description: 在摄入性会谈与登记表环节，系统记录性do not、出生年份、民族、年级/复读经历与院校等身份与教育背景信息，必要时补充籍贯、婚姻/宗教等条目，为后续评估与Intervention提供参照。
364.when_to_use: Initial-diagnosis intake interview data collection, used to build basic case files and background.
364.trigger: 首次就诊或档案缺失，基本身份与教育信息not yet被记录或not完整时。

498.skill_name: use登记表或口头询问收集人口学资料
498.skill_description: use信息/咨询表规范采集性do not、年龄、民族、在读年级等人口学资料；当来访者not愿填写表单时，改以口头询问并记录，确保基础档案完整可用。
498.when_to_use: 第1次会谈的建立关系与评估阶段开始时。
498.trigger: 首次求助且资料not yet系统记录，或来访者拒绝/尚not yet填写登记表时。

428.skill_name: 记录学业表现与社会角色
428.skill_description: 记录学习成绩、在校职务与荣誉（如党员、Student干部、奖学金等）及人际概况，描绘当前身份与责任负荷，作为社会支持与功能评估的背景数据。
428.when_to_use: When establishing the basic file and needing to assess social support and functional background.
428.trigger: When the client mentions study, grades, interpersonal interaction, or service/honor experiences.

431.skill_name: 记录在校就读与居住安排
431.skill_description: Clarify and record the current grade, whether boarding at school / whom they live with, life independence, and dormitory life, with schooling and residence information as basic data for environmental background and campus resource assessment.
431.when_to_use: The basic information segment of data collection, used when supplementing study and living environment information.
431.trigger: When the client mentions school study, accommodation arrangements, or campus resources and support systems need to be assessed.

136.skill_name: 核实家庭结构与监护/独生信息
136.skill_description: 在收集基本信息时，询问并记录家庭成员构成、是否为独生子Female及监护/照料安排，作为后续Family relationships评估与社会支持概念化的背景。
136.when_to_use: 初评收集Average资料并需了解家庭背景与监护情况时。
136.trigger: 来访者提到家庭、监护或尚Not specified家庭结构与独生情况时。

307.skill_name: 询问家庭心理与家族疾病背景
307.skill_description: Additionally verify whether the parents have personality or neurotic disorders, understand whether the family has a history of mental illness, and record it in the basic information, for comprehensive judgment of risks and resources.
307.when_to_use: At the initial assessment, supplementing family background and risk assessment, completing the basic data.
307.trigger: 父母与家族心理健康情况not明确或not yet被记录时。

198.skill_name: 获取居住与主要照料者/养育者信息
198.skill_description: Sort out past and current living arrangements and changes in the main caregivers/raising figures (such as living with grandparents or parents), record whom the client communicates with more often, in order to assess the living environment and support system.
198.when_to_use: At the initial talk or background collection, the segment of sorting out the living environment and upbringing background.
198.trigger: When the client mentions growing-up experiences or is asked about past/current living and care arrangements.

376.skill_name: 确认照护责任持续时长与日常安排
376.skill_description: 当来访者为主要照护者时，询问成为照护者的起始时间、持续时长与每日照护安排，并了解可否离开被照护者及子Female支持方式，呈现照护情境基线。
376.when_to_use: After background information collection, moving into the care situation sorting and support assessment stage.
376.trigger: When the client mentions bearing the main caregiving responsibility or describes being constrained by caregiving.

128.skill_name: 观察并记录第一印象与求助动机
128.skill_description: When entering the room and in the opening exchange, observe and record appearance and grooming, demeanor, verbal features and logical clarity, emotional presentation, and politeness, and ask about and confirm the wish/motivation for seeking help and the sense of trust, as a reference for functional status and degree of cooperation.
128.when_to_use: 首次见面与会谈开端，尚not yet充分言谈的早期阶段。
128.trigger: On entering the room, showing obvious clues such as dress and posture, speech rate and logic, actively seeking help, or expressing trust.

360.skill_name: 观察并记录外貌与当下情绪/行为
360.skill_description: At the start of the session, record observable appearance and behavioral states, such as hairstyle, clothing, face and posture, crying and reactions after being soothed, language fluency, supplementing objective descriptions of basic information and current adaptation.
360.when_to_use: At the initial visit or first-day admission assessment, used to establish baseline performance.
360.trigger: When salient appearance features or immediate emotional/behavioral reactions (such as crying or a tense posture) are available for observation.

470.skill_name: 介绍并布置思维记录表
470.skill_description: 向来访者讲解思维/情绪记录工具的结构与用途，在日常情境中记录trigger情境、自动思维、情绪强度及行为反应，并尝试写出合理反应或支持/反对证据。可在会谈中示范与练习，作为会谈间自我监测与初步检验自动思维的基础。
470.when_to_use: 咨询初期至第二阶段，当开始识do not自动思维、需要结构化梳理情绪—思维—行为关系或进入行为训练与家庭作业阶段时。
470.trigger: 来访者在典型情境中出现Anxiety、难过等not良情绪或自动思维；叙述零散难以把握规律；同伴/手足冲突、人际矛盾频发需结构化记录时。

335.skill_name: 明确记录时机并持续反馈
335.skill_description: Agree with the client on recording rules: when noticing the mood changing or worsening, immediately record the events, thoughts and emotions of the time, and in daily life continuously record emotional and behavioral changes and reactions. Bring the homework back regularly for feedback; the therapist checks and adjusts the practice when necessary, to strengthen self-awareness, self-assessment and self-guidance, and consolidate new beliefs and strategies.
335.when_to_use: When assigning a diary, simultaneously set execution standards; after homework starts, throughout the second to third stages, used for consolidation and follow-up.
335.trigger: 心境波动、低落或Anxiety出现的当下；日常出现情绪波动、行为调整或新想法时；需要在会谈中汇报进展或督促执行。

221.skill_name: 复盘日志作业并给予反馈
221.skill_description: 在后续会谈请来访者共享记录与完成情况，选取片段讨论与澄清，评估其识do not与评价自动思维的能力，纠正遗漏并正常化困难，给予肯定与鼓励，据此调整后续Intervention重点与作业安排，巩固自我监测习惯。
221.when_to_use: At the opening or orientation stage of each follow-up session, used to review homework and consolidate monitoring habits.
221.trigger: 来访者带来记录或口述作业进展、遇到记录困难或对完成度not明需核查时。

289.skill_name: 布置持续记录并促进迁移
289.skill_description: 安排每周家庭作业，持续记录重要情境中的想法、情绪与证据，将已学方法运用于not同生活场景，比较前后情绪评分与反应差异，支持行为实验与认知修正的跟踪；在随访中根据完成度与状态微调作业以提升坚持性与效果。
289.when_to_use: From after the relationship is established through the whole counseling process, after homework analysis and strategy formulation, the stage emphasizing transfer and continuous monitoring.
289.trigger: When the client forms new cognitions or coping strategies in the session, shows emotional fluctuation, or has real-life difficulties, and needs to consolidate them in daily practice and records.

288.skill_name: 教授并示范思维记录表
288.skill_description: Conduct psychoeducation, explain the connection of situation - automatic thought - emotion, demonstrate and lead practicing filling in the thought record form (one may first complete the first three columns), in concrete situations record the related evidence, helping to perceive emotions, sort out and test evidence, lower the intensity of negative emotions, and assign it as continuous recording between sessions.
288.when_to_use: 识do not负性自动思维的阶段，或需要结构化梳理时；会谈与会谈间均可use。
288.trigger: When the client shows strong emotions triggered by distorted cognitions such as mind reading, or the current emotion is strong and thinking is confused and hard to organize by oneself.

181.skill_name: 运用思维记录表进行认知重建
181.skill_description: 针对具体trigger事件填写思维记录表，检视替代解释与支持/反对证据，形成更合理的认知，并观察情绪评分变化以验证效果；将会谈外的记录过程外化为文本，回顾分析与调整以促进认知重评。
181.when_to_use: 识do not出歪曲自动思维后开展认知重建训练时，或需获取会谈外连续资料时。
181.trigger: A negative interpretation of the event is formed and the emotional score is high; a triggering situation such as 'feeling dirty' is encountered, or obsessive thoughts and cleaning compulsions appear.

268.skill_name: 回顾日志识do not自动思维与假设
268.skill_description: In subsequent sessions, jointly review the records, locate the automatic thoughts and negative assumptions in negative-emotion situations, systematically review the past week's logs and screen the typical events with high frequency and great impact, carry out a micro-analysis of cognition - emotion - behavior, as a basis for this session's agenda and further conceptualization.
268.when_to_use: Used in the second-stage psychological help (sessions 3 to 7) or follow-up; the review and agenda setting segment at the start of each session.
268.trigger: When the client brings back thought/emotion records or reports multiple distressing events, and this session's focus needs to be determined.

304.skill_name: 基于日志反馈趋势并调整策略
304.skill_description: 在后续每次会谈审阅自我监测记录，关注Anxiety评分变化与trigger模式，及时反馈进展；将代表性情境作为认知重评或行为实验的素材，并据此调整Intervention策略与家庭作业安排。
304.when_to_use: In the review stage of each follow-up or return visit, and during cognitive restructuring when the strategy needs fine-tuning based on data.
304.trigger: The log has accumulated data or scores fluctuate; specific discussable events appear in the records (such as difficulty refusing others).

437.skill_name: 布置事件—情绪—影响记录作业
437.skill_description: Require the client to recall and record the events that trouble them and the emotions at the time, and write down the possible impact on the present; or when contradiction and entanglement appear again, record the events and inner conflict and make a preliminary self-analysis. Bring the log to the next discussion, to supplement the session material and track emotional changes and cognitive adjustment.
437.when_to_use: Used after the first session, when the assessment is extended beyond the session, or in the session interval after a contact with trauma / emotional processing.
437.trigger: Face-to-face narration is scattered or omits things, important experiences are hard to detail on the spot; new insights or thoughts appear in daily life, or contradictions and entanglements are frequently reported.

138.skill_name: 检查并讨论记录中的情感与意义
138.skill_description: At the next counseling session, ask about the homework completion, invite the client to share the recorded content, and develop discussions around the feelings and meanings of each matter, used to consolidate positive experiences and promote cognitive processing and emotion regulation.
138.when_to_use: After the mood check at the start of each counseling session, when reviewing homework and discussing record content.
138.trigger: When the client brings or verbally reports records such as three daily happy events and seeks feedback.

375.skill_name: 基于日志反馈鼓励与识do not困难
375.skill_description: Based on log feedback, promptly affirm progress and stability (such as reduced frequency) and reinforce effective behavior; at the same time, discuss difficulties encountered around the diary and practice records, give understanding and normalization, reduce pressure, and optimize the next-step plan and homework.
375.when_to_use: At stage review or homework feedback, when positive changes are observed or obstacles need to be summarized and strategies adjusted.
375.trigger: Monitoring records show a decrease in the frequency of behavior (such as a decrease in the number of hand washings), or the client brings / verbally reports practice records and the problems need to be distilled.

151.skill_name: 从日志识do not模式与trigger并细化目标
151.skill_description: 带领来访者复盘日志条目，标注高发时段、主题与应对倾向（如向外求助、依赖），识do nottrigger模式并反馈，用于问题优先级排序、修订个案概念化与细化阶段性目标。
151.when_to_use: At each homework review, and when the conceptualization needs refining and stage goals need setting.
151.trigger: 日志显示日常或睡前反复担忧主题，或反复use单一应对策略导致without助感时。

186.skill_name: 回顾监测日志并提炼关键信息
186.skill_description: 在会谈中系统查看记录与监控表，检查行为频次与趋势，抽取trigger情境、自动化思维及其真实性，判断是否改善或维持，为后续辩论、演练与Intervention调整提供依据。
186.when_to_use: At the start of a phased session or at each homework review step, when at least one week of logs has been collected.
186.trigger: 来访者带来或口述已填写的记录；需评估“have not明显改善”或出现可讨论的情境与问题条目时。

461.skill_name: 巩固并安排下一周期记录
461.skill_description: At the end of each session, briefly review the week's recording progress, give reinforcement and encouragement, and invite continuing to complete the next week's diary card, maintaining the monitoring habit and data continuity; adjust arrangements when necessary to improve persistence and effect.
461.when_to_use: Before the end of each session, when the self-monitoring arrangement needs continuing and change needs consolidating.
461.trigger: 当周记录完成度not高或刚完成澄清后，需要重申并约定下一周记录时。

464.skill_name: 教授并布置三/五/七栏思维记录
464.skill_description: 教授并布置三栏/五栏/七栏表，要求在情绪或身体not适时记录情境、自动思维、情绪强度、行为反应及支持/反对证据与替代思维；现场演示五栏表填写并评估可行性，用于日常监测与会谈间家庭作业。
464.when_to_use: 第一次及之后的咨询初期，引入认知模型并开始结构化CBT流程或识do not评估自动思维时。
464.trigger: 来访者出现明显负性情绪或困扰事件；已初步理解“想法not一定是事实”，需要更结构化记录时。

325.skill_name: 运用三栏表练习识do not与回应自动思维
325.skill_description: 指导来访者将具体情境、自动思维、情绪反应系统记录于三栏表，并练习理性回应；比较前后情绪强度变化，结合场景复盘与分类，监测日常模式，逐步修正功能not良思维。
325.when_to_use: When cognitive exercises and daily monitoring are needed, especially when negative automatic thoughts frequently appear in counseling, or when extracting key material during the early stage of assessment and conceptualization.
325.trigger: 在人多或人际互动情境出现“我会not舒服”“他冷落我”等自动思维并感到Anxiety、难过，或反复出现影响大的情境时。

167.skill_description: 布置按ABC模型记录：诱发事件A、信念B、情绪/行为结果C，持续监测日常困扰；分析B中的not合理成分，并写出可替代的合理信念进行练习，为后续论辩与修正提供连续资料。
167.when_to_use: 引入合理情绪疗法/ABC理论后（第2～4次），需要在日常监测并识do notnot合理信念的阶段。
167.trigger: 情绪反应强烈且对原因困惑；近期生活事件引发not适或对抗性行为；已理解ABC模型需要在真实情境中练习记录时。

193.skill_name: 指导并收集睡眠监测关键指标
193.skill_description: 指导来访者use睡眠记录或监测工具，记录入睡潜伏期、夜间觉醒次数与时长、总睡眠时间、床上时间、起床时间与睡眠效率，并规范记录项目与周期（如连续≥7天），必要时补充白天卧床与疲劳等信息，用于评估与追踪。
193.when_to_use: 处理insomnia相关问题的评估与Intervention全程，尤其在第一次咨询后建立基线与早期追踪时。
193.trigger: 来访者报告睡眠not佳并愿意记录，或需持续化、客观化睡眠资料支撑诊断与方案；携带设备监测数据供讨论时。

520.skill_name: 用睡眠日记评估疗效并反馈调整
520.skill_description: Based on the changes in sleep efficiency, awakening counts and sleep latency in the continuous sleep diary, carry out staged assessment, affirm progress and give feedback; combined with subjective daytime functioning (dreaming situation, daytime energy, frequency of being in bed and exercise) check consistency, promptly fine-tune the intervention suggestions and homework.
520.when_to_use: At the follow-up and effect-enhancement stage of sessions 2-5, and at each follow-up reviewing recent sleep and daytime state.
520.trigger: 日记显示各项指标出现改善或恶化趋势；监测指标有变化或异常，或来访者报告做梦多、白天乏力/not卧床、运动频率变化等。

274.skill_name: 布置RET自助表记录not合理认知
274.skill_description: 布置每周RET自助表，要求在出现负性情绪时记录trigger事件与相应not合理认知，按A、C再写出B，并尝试写出可替代的合理认知，作为会谈讨论与识do not认知—情绪关系的依据，持续用于日常应用与巩固。
274.when_to_use: 第1次咨询评估阶段布置，并在第2次讲解ABC理论后与后续会谈持续use。
274.trigger: 一周内出现负面情绪体验；已理解ABC模型但仍将Anxiety归因于事件本身或难以排解冲突时。

418.skill_name: 检查与讨论RET自助表以修正信念
418.skill_description: 在下一次会谈检查RET自助表完成情况，围绕记录的错误认知与not良习惯共同分析，进行理性反驳并把握当前变化；鼓励将方法迁移到其他生活事件中，以巩固认知改变。
418.when_to_use: At the opening review of subsequent sessions or when assessing the current state, especially applicable at the second to fourth counseling stage.
418.trigger: 来访者带回已完成的RET自助表或提出记录中的困惑与困难；已意识到not合理认知但情绪反复、冲突难解时。

384.skill_name: 收集主要养育背景与照料结构
384.skill_description: Ask about and record by whom they were raised in the early years, the parents' occupations and family economic situation, family atmosphere, and the quality of the parents' relationship, and at the same time form an overall impression of and interaction tone with the caregivers, as basic material for understanding the sources of early emotional experience and sense of safety.
384.when_to_use: When early upbringing and family information are needed before longitudinal background data collection or conceptualization.
384.trigger: When the client mentions family, parents, childhood experiences, or clues such as separation from parents, family structure, and economic conditions.

516.skill_name: 探询教养方式、情感回应与关键事件
516.skill_description: 引导叙述父母的要求与管教方式、沟通与情感回应（如打骂、negate或少支持）及高期待与规则，追问与养育者相关的印象事件与当时感受，澄清其对当前认知、情绪与关系模式的长期影响线索。
516.when_to_use: In the longitudinal-conceptualization and early-experience exploration stage, when the sources of core beliefs and emotional experiences need to be understood.
516.trigger: 来访者谈及被打骂、缺少关爱、父母高期待、沟通not畅或家庭冲突等童年记忆时。

228.skill_name: 回顾养育经历与家庭/监护安排
228.skill_description: 引导回忆父母Divorced、留守祖辈生活、由谁长期抚养与居住安排等早年经历，记录对养育者的印象与情感反应，为纵向概念化提供养育与依恋背景。
228.when_to_use: In the stage of assessing family background and conducting longitudinal conceptualization, when information about early upbringing and guardianship needs to be sorted out.
228.trigger: 谈及原生家庭、祖辈养育、父母Divorced或被亲属照料的经历时。

525.skill_name: 探询父母要求与评价及其影响
525.skill_description: Ask specifically about parents' demands and criticism regarding academics/career, their core expectations and care style, and record the degree of compliance and the resulting self-evaluation and concern about others' opinions, providing a basis for subsequent belief and schema analysis.
525.when_to_use: 纵向信息采集与早年经历回顾时，需识do not父母期待与评价模式对当下影响时。
525.trigger: When the client talks about experiences of parents' strict demands, being criticized, worrying about disappointing others, or caring about evaluations.

146.skill_name: 探询养育者回应模式与教养风格
146.skill_description: Interview the client or parents about the caregivers' responses to rules and demands, companionship and participation, communication frequency, and emotional support, depicting the influence of parenting style on the client's behavior and emotions, providing input for conceptualization.
146.when_to_use: The stage of assessing family background and early parenting style, or longitudinal data collection.
146.trigger: 出现溺爱、忽视、严格管教或支持not足的线索，需澄清家庭互动模式时。

255.skill_name: 梳理父母关系冲突与关键家庭事件
255.skill_description: Understand the quality of the parents' relationship and their conflict situations, and follow up on key events such as multiple infidelities, frequent quarrels, and their effects on parenting input and the client's feelings, as important clues about the early child-rearing environment.
255.when_to_use: 教养史细化与纵向概念化输入阶段，需要识do not关键家庭事件时。
255.trigger: 谈及父母关系not佳、冲突或需要理解早期互动对当前影响的线索时。

214.skill_name: 询问父母教养风格与指导支持
214.skill_description: Ask specifically about parents' expectations and demands, the degree of guidance and support in academics and life, and parenting characteristics (e.g., indulgent, authoritarian, democratic), record points such as 'lack of correct guidance', and assess its influence on self-control and frustration coping.
214.when_to_use: 初评与纵向概念化阶段，识do not家庭教养因素作用时。
214.trigger: 来访者提及父母参与度低、应对挫折能力差或家庭支持not足、期望较高等线索时。

233.skill_name: 探询比较、惩戒与家庭氛围的影响
233.skill_description: Refine the family atmosphere and discipline strategies such as indifferent/authoritarian parenting, overprotection, comparison with and demeaning by others, intimidation or violence, and clarify their long-term influence on inferiority and the formation of rules.
233.when_to_use: At the family upbringing-style exploration and longitudinal conceptualization stage, when upbringing characteristics and influences need to be grasped.
233.trigger: The client talks about experiences of being compared, devalued, intimidated and beaten/scolded, or parents' forceful separation.

434.skill_name: 引导自述早年照护结构与养育者特征
434.skill_description: Encourage narration about nanny / grandparental caregiving, the composition and changes of the primary caregivers, the personalities and expressive styles of the caregivers and their care methods, capturing key details to understand the effect of the early interaction and attachment background on the current problem.
434.when_to_use: 进行纵向概念化与养育背景收集时。
434.trigger: When discussing childhood care, caregivers' personalities, or family member changes and care arrangements.

331.skill_name: 追问与养育者相关的关键事件与反应
331.skill_description: 围绕印象深刻事件细化情景与养育者反应（如支持缺失或相信他人），记录当时情绪与意义，识do not情感忽视与依恋体验，为理解当前困扰提供依据。
331.when_to_use: 需要识do not早年事件中照护者回应与支持质量时。
331.trigger: 来访者提到被辱骂、not被支持、被比较或强烈情绪记忆但细节not足时。

474.skill_name: 记录与养育者的冲突事件及影响
474.skill_description: Review high-conflict or extreme interaction events with caregivers and the subjective experiences (such as frequent quarrels, being demeaned), mark the emotions and meanings, and assess their impact on current beliefs, sense of security, and relational patterns.
474.when_to_use: When exploring how early parent-child interaction affects current problems and relationship patterns.
474.trigger: 来访者描述被批评deny、not被理解或家庭冲突、暴力经历时。

495.skill_name: 收集成长背景与养育者特征印象
495.skill_description: 记录家庭结构与资源、独生子Female与照料方式、主要养育者的社交与沟通特征及来访者对其的印象，提取与自理与交往能力相关的线索，用于理解当前问题。
495.when_to_use: At the cause analysis and longitudinal conceptualization stage, when growth background needs to be supplemented.
495.trigger: When talking about family circumstances, sources of personality, the client's self-care/social difficulties, or evaluations of caregiver traits.

300.skill_name: 回顾成长与抚养经历及父母期待
300.skill_description: 鼓励回顾被抚养情况、严格要求/奖励机制与父母对学业的期待等具体经历，记录当时感受，对早期Family relationships与其影响做初步梳理。
300.when_to_use: At the initial diagnosis or growth history collection stage, when learning about family education and expectations.
300.trigger: When the client mentions getting along with family, being demanded of or neglected, or begins narrating details of family upbringing.

481.skill_name: 连接当前互动模式与早年教养
481.skill_description: Through comparative questions (such as 'Does this resemble your parents' demands on you since childhood?'), help link the current way of getting along with early upbringing, and press questions about its continuing impact on current emotions and personality characteristics.
481.when_to_use: When the current interaction is suspected to be influenced by early upbringing and a connection and awareness need building.
481.trigger: When cognitive/behavioral patterns similar to early family discipline appear in the session, or the client actively establishes a connection.

534.skill_name: 回顾家庭氛围、父母关系与陪伴
534.skill_description: Guides recall of the early family atmosphere, parental relationship and conflicts, the frequency and ways of parental companionship, records the experience at the time, understanding its influence on the sense of security and emotional reactions.
534.when_to_use: During early upbringing exploration in longitudinal conceptualization or family background discussion.
534.trigger: 来访者提到家庭not和或暴力打斗、父亲长期not在家等带强情绪的经历时。

452.skill_name: 收集父母教育风格与期待及早年角色
452.skill_description: Record the parents' educational style and expectations (such as 'study hard and you will have a future') and the early family roles and responsibilities (doing housework, looking after younger siblings), understanding their influence on self-demands and interaction patterns.
452.when_to_use: In the growth and family background inquiry stage, when role and expectation information needs to be supplemented.
452.trigger: When the client talks about parents' work, expectations for study, or childhood experiences of doing housework/caring for younger siblings.

156.skill_name: 探询与养育者的关键互动与情绪
156.skill_description: Guide recall of representative interaction segments and original words with caregivers, collect high-impact events such as being accused, punished, or conflicts and the emotions at the time, and record caregivers' emotional expression and the family's emotional atmosphere, to understand the sources of beliefs.
156.when_to_use: At the stage of exploring parent-child relationship and emotional reaction details, when key fragments need to be obtained.
156.trigger: 谈及与父母的强烈情绪记忆、负性互动或出现明显情绪变化（低头、表情not自然）时。

247.skill_name: 梳理家庭结构与监护/抚养变动
247.skill_description: Along the timeline, ask about changes in the parents' marriage and custody, the main caregiver, and living arrangements, clarifying the early upbringing environment and attachment thread, providing structural background for subsequent conceptualization.
247.when_to_use: At the starting segment of collecting early upbringing history or establishing a family event timeline.
247.trigger: When the client talks about narratives such as parents arguing / divorcing, whom one lives with, or caregiver changes.

155.skill_name: 追问早年分离、照料与安全感来源
155.skill_description: Asking about experiences such as separation from parents and being cared for by grandparents, and the closeness with the parents, understanding the potential impact of early care patterns and sources of security on current problems.
155.when_to_use: 纵向发育史与早期教养信息收集阶段。
155.trigger: When the client mentions experiences of separation from parents in childhood, being raised by others, or parent-child estrangement.

161.skill_name: 回顾因父母意见而做出的关键决定
161.skill_description: Record key decisions such as academics made due to the parents' opinions and the feelings and meanings at the time, as material for grasping key nodes of upbringing influence, connecting to current beliefs and stress experiences.
161.when_to_use: 探寻养育者影响与核心信念形成时。
161.trigger: When the client narrates events such as important academic choices made according to the parents' opinions.

262.skill_name: 探询父母比较与评价方式及影响
262.skill_description: 了解是否常被拿来比较或强调短处，记录由此产生的“without能”“自卑”等自我评价与压力体验，并结合严格要求与养育风格对性格与自我要求的影响线索。
262.when_to_use: 讨论教养风格与自我概念来源阶段。
262.trigger: When the client talks about being compared, criticized, or held to high expectations, and about personality formation clues.

503.skill_name: 探询主要照料者与陪伴模式
503.skill_description: Asking who raised them, the frequency and division of parental companionship, whom they lived with from childhood and the relationship quality, to understand the early basis of emotional supply and attachment experience.
503.when_to_use: 纵向发展史与教养经历探查开端或Evaluative session时。
503.trigger: 来访者提到照料方式、Single parent成长或父母聚少离多的经历时。

403.skill_name: 评估与养育者关系质量与期待
403.skill_description: 了解与父母的亲疏印象与情感体验（如亲近或疏远）、沟通状况及被寄予厚望的期待，识do not由此形成的责任感与自我设定对当下的影响。
403.when_to_use: 将教养史转化为关系质量与信念线索时。
403.trigger: When the client talks about clues of parental expectations, closeness/distance, or lack of communication and emotional support.

350.skill_name: 询问父母期望、严格与惩罚经历
350.skill_description: Unfold around details such as whether expectations are high, demands are strict, supervision of study, and blame and corporal punishment, and assess their long-term effects on the sense of self-worth and emotion regulation, as key inputs to conceptualization.
350.when_to_use: When the influence of parenting style on the current problem needs understanding, or early upbringing is reviewed.
350.trigger: The client talks about study pressure, being strictly demanded of, being punished, or emotional reactions to family members' demands.

207.skill_name: 连接教养经历与性格应对模式
207.skill_description: Guide connecting the early experiences with current characteristics (introversion, sensitivity, poor frustration tolerance, external attribution, weak sense of control, and so on), record subjective experiences and interpretation clues, for the influence chain in the longitudinal conceptualization.
207.when_to_use: 纵向概念化前收集影响链条或识do not早期—当下连接时。
207.trigger: When the client mentions personality traits or attributions of problems being connected to early experiences.

445.skill_name: 收集与养育者相关的重大与印象事件
445.skill_description: Record concrete ages and key family events (such as a relative's death, remarriage) and the original words and situations of interaction with caregivers (being scolded, being taken away, being scolded after a burn, etc.), as material for examining upbringing relationships and belief formation.
445.when_to_use: When reviewing important nodes in interactions with caregivers or needing to understand the meaning of events.
445.trigger: 来访者提供具体时间点、强烈情绪记忆或表达被忽视、not被爱与期待的内容时。

477.skill_name: 探询家庭交流、管教方式与负性事件
477.skill_description: 追问交流是否主动、管教是否严厉，细化被批评体罚或not明原因暴打等经历，记录当时情绪与意义，提炼其对性格与当前问题的潜在影响。
477.when_to_use: 纵向概念化与背景信息收集、探索not合理信念来源时。
477.trigger: 提到父母严厉、沟通少、被暴打/羞辱或成绩not yet达理想时的处理方式时。

201.skill_name: 评估教养方式与家庭权力结构
201.skill_description: 描述父亲强势专制、说一not二与批评打压式风格，Mother温和但缺乏话语权，以及家中对情绪表达的态度，评估其对自卑与顺从等特质与规则形成的影响。
201.when_to_use: 纵向资料收集与核心信念线索探查环节。
201.trigger: When the client complains about experiences of being suppressed, being punished for expressing vulnerability, or being considered 'shameful'.

154.skill_name: 明确抚养者、父母婚姻与联络模式
154.skill_description: Confirms parents' marital status, main caregiver and frequency and quality of contact with parents, sorts out the early care structure and separation history, clarifying the attachment context and support sources.
154.when_to_use: Before longitudinal conceptualization, when needing to clarify the early upbringing environment and attachment context.
154.trigger: When the client mentions family changes, long-term separation from parents, or the main caregiver situation.

532.skill_name: 追问早期分离、寄养与沟通模式
532.skill_description: Specifically learn about childhood foster care / boarding, absence due to parents being busy, communication styles, and willingness to confide, clarify early attachment and self-soothing patterns and their current impact, and trace back the changes in infant and toddler care.
532.when_to_use: When signs of abnormal early caregiving arrangements or long-term emotional neglect appear.
532.trigger: When the client narrates experiences such as long-term care by grandparents, little communication, or changes in care during infancy and early childhood.

372.skill_name: 梳理父母关系变迁与家庭重大事件
372.skill_description: 围绕父母婚姻not和、离婚/再婚等重大事件建立时间轴，回忆当时体验与意义，呈现关系演变对情绪与适应的影响，作为纵向概念化依据。
372.when_to_use: At the stage of assessing the influence of the family of origin and parent-child relationships, and longitudinal conceptualization.
372.trigger: 来访者提及Divorced/再婚、与继亲相处或被隐瞒家庭事件等内容时。

442.skill_name: 探查寄养经历、分离与其影响
442.skill_description: Clarify the foster-care duration and carers, changes of caregivers and boarding experiences, and record the quality of communication and the emotions at the time; assess the effects on attachment and emotional development, and connect them to changes in personality and social interaction.
442.when_to_use: 教养史具体事件探询或家谱图讨论中。
442.trigger: When being fostered, parents being away, boarding-school attendance, or clues of personality / social changes are mentioned.

349.skill_name: 梳理主要养育者、抚养方式与期待
349.skill_description: 梳理主要养育者与抚养方式（聚少离多、由Mother带大、重视成绩、要求严格）及来访者印象，作为纵向概念化中信念形成的背景线索。
349.when_to_use: Developmental history collection and family background exploration before longitudinal conceptualization.
349.trigger: When the client mentions content such as who mainly raised them, parents' upbringing style, and expectations about grades.

391.skill_name: 访谈早年教养、关系及关键事件影响
391.skill_description: 详细访谈随祖辈成长、父母Divorced与情感忽视等经历对自卑敏感与人际信任的影响，并补充成长环境与物质条件、交流质量等信息以支持概念化。
391.when_to_use: At the stage of exploring early upbringing and family of origin, collecting material for longitudinal conceptualization.
391.trigger: When the client starts talking about the family of origin, the caregivers, childhood experiences, family resources, and communication quality.

302.skill_name: Forming and recording diagnostic conclusions and their basis (including service scope and comorbidity)
302.skill_description: 在证据支持下给出诊断结论（如Average心理问题/具体表述），条目化陈述依据（症状四维度、病程与功能、量表分、排除项等），确认自知力完整、without幻觉妄想与重大躯体异常，必要时识do not并记录共病或特质，界定咨询范畴与服务去向。
302.when_to_use: After completing data integration and scale interpretation, when the diagnosis needs to be fed back before entering goal and plan formulation.
302.trigger: Diagnostic cues are sufficient and psychotic and severe problems have been excluded; scale and clinical information are consistent, or a hospital diagnosis is held and needs to be included in records with explanation.

453.skill_name: 系统评估精神状态与社会功能以支持鉴do not
453.skill_description: 系统检查并记录感知觉、思维、情绪、自知力、知情意一致性及人格特点，观察衣着体态与情感表达一致性，并评估学习、人际等社会功能，判定是否存在精神病性特征，为鉴do not与诊断提供依据。
453.when_to_use: At the initial consultation and psychological diagnosis part, used to establish a mental status baseline and rule out psychotic manifestations.
453.trigger: 来访者Low mood、Anxiety或功能下降，需明确有without知觉或思维异常及社会功能受损程度时。

358.skill_name: 实施鉴do not诊断与安全性评估
358.skill_description: 评估自知力、思维与知觉（幻觉、妄想）、suicideself-mutilation风险，收集家族与躯体/神经病史，排除精神病性障碍与物质/躯体因素；并综合病程特征与反应是否泛化作初步表述，明确转介必要性。
358.when_to_use: Before making a formal diagnosis, and when atypical presentations appear or symptoms worsen.
358.trigger: 首次评估或出现感知异常、self-injury意念、药物/疾病线索、合作性差等风险信号。

314.skill_name: 形成“Average心理问题”诊断并记录依据
314.skill_description: 整合访谈、测评与鉴do not结果，依据病与非病三原则、病程与功能、量表分等关键指标，明确“Average心理问题”的诊断，记录可追溯依据，并据此确定后续咨询目标、方案与服务设置。
314.when_to_use: 完成资料收集与鉴do not后，需要确定并记录最终诊断及其依据时。
314.trigger: Psychosis, neurosis, and severe psychological problems have been ruled out, scales and clinical judgment agree, and the social function impact is relatively light.

313.skill_name: 评估病程、泛化与功能受损排除严重问题
313.skill_description: 核查持续时间是否短（约一至两月内）、反应是否局限于特定情境、对社会功能的损害是否轻微且not yet泛化，据此排除严重心理问题并界定严重度与Intervention紧迫性。
313.when_to_use: 进行严重程度分级与功能评估、在形成初步诊断前的鉴do not环节。
313.trigger: 虽有Anxiety或学习Decreased efficiency，但能正常学习工作；症状局限、病程not足两月、社会功能not yet广泛受损。

276.skill_name: 依据症状学标准判定严重心理问题
276.skill_description: 逐项核对Anxiety相关症状与其对日常生活的影响，评估情绪反应是否已泛化及病程是否逾两个月；当多项症状明显且功能受损显著、病程较长时，归类为严重心理问题。
276.when_to_use: After excluding psychosis, when needing to determine problem grade and severity.
276.trigger: 存在多项Anxiety相关症状，学习与日常生活受影响，病程持续两个月以上。

465.skill_name: 精神状态检查与精神病性/suicide风险排查
465.skill_description: 在会谈中检查并记录有without幻觉、妄想等精神病性症状及suicide意念或行为，明确“有/without”，结合自知力与逻辑思维判断，作为风险分级与诊断边界的依据。
465.when_to_use: During risk assessment in the diagnostic stage and excluding severe mental disorders.
465.trigger: 来访者提及异常知觉、被害想法、self-injury/suicide念头，或需常规排查严重风险时。

438.skill_name: 结合症状学、病程与功能进行分类判断
438.skill_description: 对照症状学标准评估Anxiety等核心症状强度，结合是否泛化、社会功能影响与病程长度，判断为Average心理问题并排除严重或神经症性问题，明确Intervention层级。
438.when_to_use: After symptom presentations are clarified, when severity and course need to be assessed for classification judgment.
438.trigger: 症状局限于特定情境、not yet泛化；社会功能not yet严重受损；病程约一月左右。

270.skill_name: 系统评估精神状态与社会功能支持诊断
270.skill_description: 依据面谈观察衣着体态、言语清晰度、自知力、有without幻觉妄想、情感表达一致性，并核查人际与学习等社会功能，形成对问题性质与严重度的初步判断，支持工作诊断与咨询适宜性评估。
270.when_to_use: The assessment, diagnosis, and relationship-building stage (interviews 1-2), before preliminary diagnosis.
270.trigger: 面谈中出现Low mood、交流被动、言语简短等表现，需判断症状性质与严重度时。

218.skill_name: 整合多源证据形成诊断结论与严重度
218.skill_description: 整合量表、自陈/他评与精神状态观察，关注insomnia、食欲差、反复self-injury企图及社会功能受损等线索，形成对问题性质与严重程度的临床判断，明确诊断并沟通作为后续方案依据。
218.when_to_use: After the preliminary scale interpretation, when objective scores need to be verified and integrated with the narrative and behavior.
218.trigger: 量表与访谈资料齐备，如Anxiety/抑郁水平提示与功能受损并存，需下达清晰结论时。

195.skill_name: 以现实契合度与病程排除神经症性问题
195.skill_description: 核查症状是否与现实诱发事件相符、持续时长较短、功能受损较轻且not yet泛化，据此排除神经症性问题，并作为诊断定位的重要依据。
195.when_to_use: Anxiety present抑郁等症状但需区分是否为神经症性问题时。
195.trigger: 症状由具体生活事件trigger，持续约数周至一月，社会功能影响较轻、not yet见明显泛化。

285.skill_name: 形成初步诊断并条目化记录依据
285.skill_description: Combine information such as course, symptoms and severity, functional impairment, and whether it has generalized, form a preliminary diagnosis and list the core bases item by item (such as being triggered by realistic stimuli, duration, functional impact); when supported by evidence, give the concrete classification and severity explanation.
285.when_to_use: At the diagnostic stage of the first consultation or after data collection is complete, when a preliminary diagnosis needs to be proposed and its basis explained.
285.trigger: 来访者报告Anxiety/insomnia持续超数周，学习Decreased efficiency、人际疏远，或量表提示相应水平。

147.skill_name: 核实既往医学诊断与治疗史并进行医疗排查
147.skill_description: Coordinate, or based on existing medical-visit results, exclude organic lesions, check past hospital diagnoses against the current medication status, and incorporate medical information into the psychological-diagnosis reference, clarifying the boundaries of counseling and the service path.
147.when_to_use: In the assessment stage, when physical and psychological factors need to be distinguished and whether medical treatment should come first or an external diagnosis integrated needs to be clarified.
147.trigger: 主诉伴躯体not适或已就医；来访/家属提及既往诊断与用药情况。

202.skill_name: 系统梳理并记录症状与功能影响
202.skill_description: Sort out self-reported symptoms along dimensions such as emotion, cognition, behavior, and physiology, record impacts on study and life, and combine counselor observations (such as tearful complaints, irritability) with accompanying sleep/appetite changes, forming structured diagnostic clues.
202.when_to_use: At the first two sessions of the psychological diagnosis stage, when the current symptom spectrum and degree of functional impairment need to be clarified.
202.trigger: 来访者报告Low mood、睡眠差、注意力差等，并描述对上课、作业与人际的影响。

400.skill_name: Administering and interpreting scales such as SAS/SDS/SCL-90 to support diagnosis
400.skill_description: 实施并解读SAS、SDS、SCL-90等量表，计算标准分与因子分，量化Anxiety/抑郁及相关维度，作为确定问题性质与严重程度、建立基线与随访对比的客观依据。
400.when_to_use: At initial consultation or when a scale baseline and diagnostic basis need to be established; phased assessments are used to compare changes.
400.trigger: Anxiety present/抑郁主诉、睡眠食欲受影响或需客观量化严重度与进展时。

507.skill_name: 梳理病程与泛化判断级do not与严重度
507.skill_description: 明确症状持续时间、是否向他处泛化及对学习与人际等功能的影响，结合短时程与局限性或长期持续与广泛受损，判定Average/严重心理问题级do not。
507.when_to_use: When conducting timeline verification and course sorting before forming a psychological diagnosis, or grading severity.
507.trigger: 来访者能提供起始时间与持续时长，报告Decreased efficiency但功能总体保持或持续较久且影响广泛。

471.skill_name: 观察精神状态并常规suicide风险询问
471.skill_description: 会谈中记录仪表、目光交流、语速与姿态等精神状态线索，结合Anxiety/抑郁生理表现并直接询问suicide意念或计划，规范记录结果，辅助严重性与安全性判断。
471.when_to_use: At diagnostic verification in initial assessment and reassessment, or when scales and chief-complaint evidence need supplementing.
471.trigger: 出现低能量、少言、语速变慢或Anxiety神情、出汗等特征，或言语涉及消极念头时。

273.skill_name: 评估精神/生理/社会功能受损并初步归类
273.skill_description: Systematically record mental/emotional manifestations such as tension and irritability, physiological states such as sleep and appetite, and social functioning changes such as study and socializing, comprehensively analyze functional impairment, preliminarily categorize the problem's nature, and record points such as insight to guide subsequent intervention.
273.when_to_use: At the first-session assessment stage, used to determine the nature of the problem and form a preliminary diagnostic impression.
273.trigger: 来访者报告Decreased efficiency、Reduced socializing，并伴随明显的Anxiety或生理反应。

448.skill_name: 排除器质性病变与精神病性障碍
448.skill_description: 依据病史与精神状态检查、体检/就诊资料与家族史，确认without器质性病变与精神病性症状，必要时参照医院检查与诊断进行排除，作为心理诊断前置鉴do not基础。
448.when_to_use: At the early stage of assessment and diagnosis, when organic lesions and psychotic disorders need to be excluded first.
448.trigger: 主诉Anxiety/睡眠差等而躯体病因not明，或已获医学检查提示“without器质性病变”。

414.skill_name: 依据功能保持与局限性排除严重心理问题
414.skill_description: 检查学习、人际与行为功能是否总体保持、问题是否局限于特定关系/场景、持续时间是否not足两个月；若功能完整且not yet泛化，原则上排除严重心理问题。
414.when_to_use: 严重程度分级与转介判断前。
414.trigger: 能参加Student活动并正常互动，困难局限于单一情境或短期波动。

292.skill_name: 访谈式评估并分级suicide/self-injury风险
292.skill_description: 具体化询问suicide意念的有without、频率、最近一次、方式与计划性，结合近期行为与功能，记录风险等级（如偶有念头但可控制→低风险）及保护因素，指导安全与Intervention安排。
292.when_to_use: During depressive symptom assessment and working diagnosis, or when negative thoughts and functional decline appear.
292.trigger: 来访者报告suicide想法、despair感或有self-injury行为史，即便频率低且可自控。

321.skill_name: 高风险时启动危机Intervention与安全处置
321.skill_description: 在确认存在suicide意念/意图与self-injury史等高危线索后，及时启动危机Intervention程序，必要时签订安全协议并Reinforcement支持网络，保障安全并为后续诊治争取时间。
321.when_to_use: At the first session or assessment update, once assessed as medium-high risk, immediate handling is required.
321.trigger: 来访者描述具体self-injury/suicide计划或曾实施危险行为，频繁冲动与极度痛苦。

318.skill_name: 识do not诱发事件、主导问题及共病关系
318.skill_description: 梳理具体诱发事件（如考试、分手等）与症状关联，判定主导问题（如以Anxiety为主）并识do notAnxiety引发抑郁等共病或主次关系，用以归类为Average心理问题与确定Intervention优先级。
318.when_to_use: 诊断评估阶段，需要定位症状trigger因素与问题主次关系时。
318.trigger: 叙述近期显著刺激事件伴Anxiety/睡眠差与学习受影响，量表提示主导维度突出。

187.skill_name: 整理并陈述诊断依据与初步结论
187.skill_description: 将量表、观察与鉴do not结论整合为明确条目（如病程、功能受损、泛化情况等），形成初步诊断或工作诊断并记录排除路径与支持证据，必要时向来访者解释以增强理解。
187.when_to_use: 完成量表、访谈与鉴do not流程后，需要给出并记录诊断结论时。
187.trigger: Evidence is sufficient (such as scales indicating mild-to-moderate level, limited functional impact); diagnostic transparency and traceability need to be ensured.

522.skill_name: 运用“三原则”并逐项鉴do not排除
522.skill_description: Check according to the 'three principles' of illness versus non-illness: unity of subjectivity and objectivity, inner coordination, and personality stability, insight and whether hallucinations or delusions exist; and combining whether there is a formless conflict, functional impairment, and course/generalization, exclude item by item psychotic, neurotic, and severe psychological problems.
522.when_to_use: 初步诊断之后，为确保诊断准确性需排除其他类do not障碍时。
522.trigger: not yet见精神病性体征，自知力完整；冲突具现实意义且社会功能受影响有限、病程短。

352.skill_name: 解读心理测评并必要时建议医学评估
352.skill_description: 整合SCL-90、SAS、SDS等测评结果与常模，标定症状谱与严重程度（如轻度抑郁/without明显Anxiety），作为诊断佐证；当抑郁倾向且功能受损持续时，建议医院进一步诊断与评估药物治疗需求。
352.when_to_use: After completing psychological assessment or when objective indicators are needed to calibrate the diagnosis and whether medical evaluation is needed.
352.trigger: 获得量表分数提示异常并伴insomnia等持续症状，或主诉与量表需交叉验证时。

219.skill_name: 复测与随访比较以更新诊断印象
219.skill_description: 在Intervention随访期重复施测SAS/SDS等量表并进行追踪访谈，比较前后变化（如Anxiety/抑郁由中度降至轻度），据此修订诊断与方案并记录进展。
219.when_to_use: 初步Intervention开始后或阶段性评估节点，需要评估疗效与状态演变时。
219.trigger: Entering the follow-up stage or the client reports a change in state, and previously abnormal scores need verification of the improvement trend.

311.skill_name: 与神经症/Anxiety性神经症的鉴do not与排除
311.skill_description: 参照神经症特点，核查痛苦程度、社会功能受损、是否出现回避与泛化及病程（如是否超过半年），并结合冲突的现实性与评分结果，判断是否达到神经症标准，not yet达则予以排除。
311.when_to_use: 存在明显Anxiety/抑郁表现但性质与持续性尚需澄清时。
311.trigger: Anxiety与现实事件直接相关、病程短、功能基本维持，not yet见广泛回避或泛化迹象。

518.skill_name: 解读SCL-90界定症状维度与严重度
518.skill_description: 依据SCL-90总分、阳性项目与因子分，识do not人际敏感、抑郁、Anxiety、偏执等高分维度，界定总体严重度与症状谱，辅助形成诊断与随访的量化依据。
518.when_to_use: After completing psychological testing, the severity definition before making a diagnostic judgment.
518.trigger: When an SCL-90 factor score or total score is significantly elevated and the abnormal dimensions and overall severity need to be determined.

226.skill_name: Administering and interpreting SCL-90 / SAS / SDS to quantify severity
226.skill_description: 经同意后实施SCL-90、SAS、SDS，计算标准分与因子分，判定Anxiety/抑郁与相关维度严重程度，记录结果作为诊断与疗效评估的客观依据与基线。
226.when_to_use: At the first assessment or when a fuller understanding of emotional state and severity and a baseline are needed.
226.trigger: 来访者自述Anxiety、易怒、睡眠/食欲问题，或需对比前后变化时。

211.skill_name: 运用“病与非病三原则”判do not病理性并排除精神病性问题
211.skill_description: Check the three principles - unity of subjective and objective, coordination of mental activities, and stability of personality - assess insight and whether hallucinations or delusions exist, to distinguish normal reactions from psychological disorders and rule out psychotic problems, clarifying whether the case falls within the scope of psychological counseling.
211.when_to_use: 评估与诊断初期，需区分精神病性与Average心理问题、判定病非界限时。
211.trigger: 虽有Anxietyinsomnia等主诉，但逻辑思维正常、情绪与情境相称、社会功能基本完好。

217.skill_name: Implementing and recording PCL-C/SAS/SCL-90 assessments and interpreting them
217.skill_description: Select the PCL-C, SAS, SCL-90, etc. for administration, completely record raw scores, factor scores, and positive items, interpret according to the threshold system and form a preliminary diagnostic impression, as a basis for diagnostic judgment and severity grading.
217.when_to_use: Evaluative session中间阶段，需要客观量化症状严重度并为诊断提供证据时。
217.trigger: 持续低落、insomnia、严重Anxiety或功能受损表现，需量表量化与诊断支持时。

458.skill_name: 识do not常形冲突以排除神经症性问题
458.skill_description: 判断心理冲突是否由现实因素引发且与处境相符、具道德色彩与常形特点；当情绪反应可理解且not yet广泛泛化时，排除神经症性问题，避免过度病理化。
458.when_to_use: 鉴do not诊断阶段，与神经症性问题进行区分时。
458.trigger: The problem originates from real events such as work / study / intimate relationships, the reaction range and objects are limited, and functioning stays basically stable.

357.skill_name: 用SCL-90筛查症状谱与共病倾向
357.skill_description: 施测并解读SCL-90总分与因子分，标注≥2的高分维度（如抑郁、Anxiety、强迫、人际敏感等），识do not症状谱与潜在共病线索，作为方案制定与随访对比的参考。
357.when_to_use: When the initial consultation requires broad screening of other psychological symptoms or suspicion of comorbidity, and when establishing a baseline.
357.trigger: Besides the predominant problem, other distress is reported, or the scale shows multiple elevated factors requiring comprehensive assessment.

163.skill_name: Integrate results such as SCL-90/SAS/EPQ to corroborate the diagnosis
163.skill_description: 整合SCL-90、SAS/SDS与EPQ等测评结果，关注Anxiety因子与标准分、抑郁严重度及人格特质，校准与临床访谈一致性，必要时微调诊断假设并明确重点维度。
163.when_to_use: After the interview, when objective indicators are needed to assist diagnosis and grading, or after completing the assessment, when clinical judgment needs calibration.
163.trigger: When scale results are available and indicate elevated relevant dimensions or personality tendencies that need cross-validation with the chief complaint.

478.skill_name: 依“三原则”结合自知力排除重性精神病
478.skill_description: 依据精神活动正常与异常的三原则，结合自知力、主动求助与not yet见幻觉妄想、思维紊乱等线索，记录排除重性精神病的理由，完成关键鉴do not并为后续诊断定向。
478.when_to_use: 在鉴do not是否存在重性精神病的早期筛查与诊断阶段。
478.trigger: 来访者能意识到异常并主动求助，现实接触Good，not yet见精神病性症状。

435.skill_name: 解释并反馈量表结果给来访者及家属
435.skill_description: Use interpretation techniques to feed back the SDS/SAS scores and meanings to the client and their father, clarify the current state and risks, enhance consistent understanding of the problem, promote cooperation and motivation for subsequent intervention, and connect to follow-up plans.
435.when_to_use: After scale administration is completed and results obtained, at the feedback segment of the initial consultation or assessment stage.
435.trigger: 测评显示轻度抑郁或中度Anxiety等结果，来访者及家属对分数含义与后续计划存疑或需要统一认知。

317.skill_name: 解读并记录量表结果判定严重程度与特征
317.skill_description: 整理并解读测评结果，如依据SAS判断Anxiety级do not，结合SCL-90因子与总分识do not显著症状领域，参照EPQ确定人格倾向，并将结论记录在评估与诊断中，为后续目标与方案提供依据。
317.when_to_use: After testing is completed and scores are obtained, when writing the assessment and diagnosis or discussing results with the client.
317.trigger: The test report is generated and includes key scores, factors, and personality dimension information.

436.skill_name: Re-administering SAS / SDS and comparing before-and-after to evaluate counseling effects
436.skill_description: 在Consolidation and termination前再次让来访者完成Anxiety与抑郁自评量表，比较前后分值变化，以客观评定咨询效果并作为阶段性或结案依据；记录标准分变化用于效果评价与方案调整。
436.when_to_use: When counseling enters the late stage or closing assessment and periodic summary, when treatment outcomes need quantitative re-checking.
436.trigger: 症状已有改善迹象或需对Intervention效果进行客观验证与记录，准备进行阶段评估或结束咨询。

432.skill_name: 初次评估施测SAS/SDS建立焦抑基线
432.skill_description: 在首次评估中施测SAS与SDS，量化Anxiety、抑郁程度，获取标准分与临床分级，作为诊断与后续复测比较的基线，并补充会谈资料。
432.when_to_use: 心理评估和诊断阶段（第一次咨询），需要客观量化Anxiety与抑郁症状时。
432.trigger: 来访者主诉伤心、心烦意乱、焦躁not安、睡眠差、学习Decreased efficiency等情绪困扰，需评定严重程度。

283.skill_name: At the initial diagnosis, administer SAS/SDS/SCL-90 and quantify symptoms
283.skill_description: 在初诊阶段施测SAS、SDS与SCL-90，获取标准分与因子得分，客观量化Anxiety等症状，为初步诊断与问题严重程度判断提供依据。
283.when_to_use: 第1次咨询的诊断阶段，需要对来访者的Anxiety、insomnia等症状进行客观量化与初步诊断时。
283.trigger: 来访者主诉Anxiety、心慌、insomnia等；仅凭口述not足以判断严重程度或需客观化信息时。

351.skill_name: 量表前后比较并评估咨询效果
351.skill_description: Repeatedly administer SCL-90, SAS, and SDS before and after counseling, compare the score changes and calculate the score-reduction rate, combined with the improvement in social functioning, quantitatively evaluate the intervention effect and the course-of-treatment outcome.
351.when_to_use: At the assessment/closing stage or when a stage review needs to summarize the treatment effect.
351.trigger: 完成一段Intervention周期，需量化疗效或决定是否调整方案时。

162.skill_name: 分析并反馈测验结果以制定咨询方案
162.skill_description: Combine the SCL-90, SAS, and EPQ scores with the client's statements, interpret the test results and give feedback, and on this basis clarify the nature and severity of the problem, and then determine the counseling method and subsequent goals.
162.when_to_use: The segment after initial scale administration is completed, for result feedback and formulating the counseling plan.
162.trigger: Scale scoring is complete and the assessment findings need to be explained to the client, with the subsequent counseling method and plan clarified.

316.skill_name: 征得同意后选择并施测针对性量表
316.skill_description: Based on the characteristics of the client's problem, after obtaining their consent, select strongly targeted scales (such as the SAS, SCL-90, EPQ) for administration, obtain standardized data, supplement session materials, and provide a basis for judging severity and personality characteristics.
316.when_to_use: At the initial consultation or assessment stage, when objective quantitative information is needed to support judgment and set goals.
316.trigger: 来访者呈现Anxiety、Sleep disorder、人际困扰等主诉并同意接受心理测验。

296.skill_name: 施测并解读SAS判定Anxiety严重程度
296.skill_description: 选用Anxiety自评量表（SAS）进行标准化测评，计算并解读标准分，量化当前Anxiety水平，辅助判断有withoutAnxiety症状并与会谈信息互证，作为后续Intervention参考。
296.when_to_use: 首次访谈需量化身心状态，或来访者报告情绪波动、insomnia、担心等Anxiety相关表现时。
296.trigger: 来访者自述情绪波动大、长期insomnia、对not yet来担心等；需客观化Anxiety水平。

303.skill_name: 整合测评与症状资料形成诊断倾向
303.skill_description: 将SAS、SDS分数与来访者的症状描述、社会功能受损等资料综合分析，判断强迫倾向及伴随的Anxiety、抑郁程度，形成初步诊断与问题表述，并将测验结果纳入诊断依据。
303.when_to_use: After the preliminary interview and scale assessment are completed, when assessment and diagnostic conclusions need to be made.
303.trigger: SAS/SDS results have been obtained, and key information such as symptom duration and functional impact has been grasped.

450.skill_name: 阶段性复测SDS/SAS监测变化与疗效
450.skill_description: During counseling, at key nodes (such as the early stage and the ninth session), administer SDS and SAS, compare the scores before and after to assess emotional changes and intervention effects, providing a basis for plan adjustment and case closing.
450.when_to_use: Before and after the middle and consolidation stages of formal counseling, or when retesting is needed to monitor progress.
450.trigger: 需要评估Intervention成效或考虑阶段转换/结束；来访者状态出现明显改善或持续困扰。

134.skill_name: Interpreting SDS/SAS scores to determine severity and forming conclusions
134.skill_description: 依据SDS与SAS得分及分界区间，判定抑郁/Anxiety级do not（如轻、中、重），形成简明结论用于评估、沟通与记录，支撑后续决策。
134.when_to_use: 量表评分出炉后，在个案评估总结与初步诊断环节use。
134.trigger: SDS or SAS scores indicate a moderate-to-high level, and the nature and severity of the problem need to be clarified.

234.skill_name: 依据量表结果建议就医确诊
234.skill_description: 当量表结果提示中度Anxiety或中至重度抑郁时，向来访者明确说明测试结论并建议尽快前往专业医疗机构进行进一步诊断评估，以获得规范治疗意见。
234.when_to_use: Used when preliminary assessment scores reach the relevant diagnostic threshold or suggest a moderate-to-severe problem and medical diagnosis and treatment advice are needed.
234.trigger: SAS标准分约63提示中度Anxiety；SDS指数约0.62提示中至重度抑郁。

332.skill_name: 阶段性复测并比较前后分数评估Intervention效果
332.skill_description: 在Intervention结束或阶段性节点复测同一量表，比较前后分数变化，评估效果与症状改善程度，用数据验证目标达成。
332.when_to_use: 咨询进入巩固或总结阶段、需要评估Intervention效果时。
332.trigger: 完成既定Intervention次数或需要验证目标达成与症状变化。

242.skill_name: 复测同一量表并对比评估疗效变化
242.skill_description: 在效果评估阶段复测相同量表，比较前后标准分变化以判断Anxiety等是否缓解，量化Intervention效果与变化趋势，用于阶段性小结或结束决策。
242.when_to_use: At the stage summary or the end of counseling, used to evaluate treatment effects and change trends.
242.trigger: Intervention实施一段时间后需要客观验证症状变化与疗效时。

524.skill_description: useSAS量表评估来访者的Anxiety情绪强度，计算总分并依据量表标准判定严重程度（如中度），形成量化结论，作为Anxiety问题判断与Intervention的基线参考。
524.when_to_use: 初诊或Intervention前，需量化Anxiety水平并判定严重程度时。
524.trigger: 来访者以Fear, tension、not安为主要主诉，需要明确Anxiety程度。

533.skill_name: 施测SDS量化抑郁程度并解释结果
533.skill_description: At the first session, select the SDS to quantitatively assess depression level, record raw and standard scores, interpret with reference to norms and clarify the current depression severity, supplementing session information and providing a basis for subsequent goals and plans.
533.when_to_use: At the initial consultation or assessment stage, when it is necessary to objectively understand the degree of depression and supplement session information.
533.trigger: 来访者报告持续Low mood、insomnia、易激惹、退学意愿等抑郁相关表现。

150.skill_name: 施测并解读SCL-90量化多维症状谱
150.skill_description: 施测并解读SCL‑90总分、阳性项目数与各因子分，结合常模识do notAnxiety、抑郁、人际敏感、敌对等突出维度，量化症状范围与严重度，为评估与概念化提供客观依据。
150.when_to_use: Used in the initial assessment stage, when the symptom spectrum and breadth of distress need to be objectively understood, providing a baseline for conceptualization and goal setting.
150.trigger: 来访者自述Anxiety、烦躁、睡眠困扰等多方面not适，口述信息not足以界定严重程度或范围时。

278.skill_name: 前后测对比量化呈现疗效与变化
278.skill_description: 在咨询后期重复use同一量表，比较前后得分变化（如成瘾、Social avoidance、睡眠、AAQ-II），检验Intervention成效并总结效果，支撑结案评估。
278.when_to_use: When counseling enters summary or phased assessment, used to verify the degree of improvement and goal attainment.
278.trigger: Intervention实施多次后需客观验证改变或为咨询效果提供证据。

267.skill_name: 施测SCL-90并完成知情同意建立基线
267.skill_description: 在初访评估阶段说明并完成知情同意，指导填写含SCL-90的记录表，获取抑郁、Anxiety等症状的量化基线数据，为后续评估与方案制定提供依据。
267.when_to_use: In the first-stage assessment, diagnosis, and counseling-relationship building stage (sessions 1-2), when a quantitative baseline needs to be established.
267.trigger: At the start of the initial counseling, when the client's symptom state needs to be understood systematically, or when screening indicates abnormality and assessment begins.

272.skill_name: 采用SCL-90前后测比较监测疗效
272.skill_description: 在Intervention前后各进行一次SCL-90测评，对比躯体化、抑郁、Anxiety等因子分变化，以客观评估症状改善与主观困扰的降低，为疗效判断提供证据。
272.when_to_use: 阶段性复盘或结束阶段，需要评估Intervention效果时。
272.trigger: Treatment has proceeded to a set node (such as stage end or case closing), or the client reports symptom changes needing objective verification.

440.skill_name: 复测SCL-90并对照变化评估效果
440.skill_description: 在Intervention后或结案前复测SCL-90（及TAS），与初测对照，观察因子分是否回归常模范围，以评估Anxiety等症状缓解与咨询效果。
440.when_to_use: 阶段性评估或结束咨询前，需要验证Intervention效果与症状改善的时点。
440.trigger: 来访者反馈Anxiety降低、能静心学习、社交改善，需以量化数据核实主观改善。

483.skill_name: 随访阶段复测量表监测维持效果
483.skill_description: At the counseling ending or follow-up nodes, administer again scales consistent with the baseline (such as the SDS, LSAS, AIS/SAS), compare the changes in scores and levels, assess the maintenance of efficacy and symptom changes, as a basis for follow-up visits and subsequent suggestions.
483.when_to_use: At the end of a counseling stage or at follow-up assessment, when effect changes or maintenance need to be objectively quantified.
483.trigger: At the two-week or three-month follow-up, the client's subjective feedback of improvement needs quantitative verification or symptom fluctuation is reported.

504.skill_name: 施测并解读EPQ识do not人格倾向
504.skill_description: 施测EPQ并报告E、N、P、L各维度分数，识do not外倾—内倾、情绪not稳定与掩饰倾向等人格背景，辅助个案概念化与方案选择。
504.when_to_use: 初始评估需了解人格特质对问题的影响，以支持个案概念化与风险识do not时。
504.trigger: 来访者在人际与情绪反应上呈敏感、冲动或敌对等特征，性格倾向not清晰。
